name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Pan con Lechón (Slow-Roasted Pork on Cuban Bread)
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted citrus-garlic pork shoulder (mojo pulled pork) on warm, crusty Cuban bread. Shredded pork is tender and easy to break down. Hold raw mojo onions for lowest FODMAP impact.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pan con Lechón sandwich; request to hold pickled raw mojo onions.
watchOuts: Hold raw pickled onions to prevent allium gas
